message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (around mid‑2024), 1 USD ≈ 0.77 GBP, so:

\[
\$20 \times 0.77 \approx £15.40
\]

So you’d expect roughly **£15–£16** for $20. Keep in mind that actual amounts may vary slightly depending on the exact rate at the time of your transaction and any fees applied by banks or currency‑exchange services.
